key_files.run_genus_mc.tcl:
# Auto-generated generic Genus Tcl
if {![info exists ::env(GENUS_LIBS)] || [string trim $::env(GENUS_LIBS)] eq ""} {
    puts "ERROR: Set GENUS_LIBS to one or more SKY130A .lib files before running Genus."
    exit 2
}

# Resolve TOP in this order:
#   1) env(TOP) override
#   2) top_module.txt (generated by prep)
#   3) fallback default
set TOP "ddr4_controller_top"
if {[info exists ::env(TOP)] && [string trim $::env(TOP)] ne ""} {
    set TOP [string trim $::env(TOP)]
} elseif {[file exists "./top_module.txt"]} {
    set fh [open "./top_module.txt" r]
    set TOP [string trim [read $fh]]
    close $fh
    if {$TOP eq ""} { set TOP "ddr4_controller_top" }
}

set FILELIST [file normalize "./filelist_genus.f"]
set SDC [file normalize "./constraints/mc_genus.sdc"]
set OUTDIR [file normalize "./../build_genus_mc"]

# Optional macro hook:
# If your design requires preprocessor defines, set env(HDL_DEFINES) to a space-separated list,
# e.g.  export HDL_DEFINES="FOO BAR=1".  This bundle's README reports no detected macros.
set HDL_DEFINES ""
if {[info exists ::env(HDL_DEFINES)]} { set HDL_DEFINES [string trim $::env(HDL_DEFINES)] }

# Read HDL; apply defines only if provided
if {$HDL_DEFINES ne ""} {
    puts "HDL_DEFINES = $HDL_DEFINES"
    read_hdl -sv -define $HDL_DEFINES -f $FILELIST
} else {
    read_hdl -sv -f $FILELIST
}
set SDC [file normalize "./constraints/mc_genus.sdc"]
set OUTDIR [file normalize "./../build_genus_mc"]

file mkdir $OUTDIR
file mkdir $OUTDIR/reports
file mkdir $OUTDIR/results

set lib_list [split $::env(GENUS_LIBS)]
set PREPDIR [file dirname $FILELIST]
set_db init_hdl_search_path [list $PREPDIR [file join $PREPDIR rtl]]
set_db init_lib_search_path [list [file dirname [lindex $lib_list 0]]]
set_db library $lib_list
set_db hdl_language sv
set_db information_level 7
set_db hdl_append_generic_ports 0
set_db hdl_resolve_parameterized_instance_with_structural_module true
catch {set_db hdl_track_filename_row_col true}

set ACTIVE_DEFINES [list none]
if {[info exists ::env(GENUS_DEFINES)] && [string trim $::env(GENUS_DEFINES)] ne ""} {
    set ACTIVE_DEFINES [split $::env(GENUS_DEFINES)]
}
if {[llength $ACTIVE_DEFINES] > 0} {
    set_db hdl_define $ACTIVE_DEFINES
}
puts "DEFINES  = $ACTIVE_DEFINES"

puts "TOP      = $TOP"
puts "FILELIST = $FILELIST"
puts "SDC      = $SDC"
puts "OUTDIR   = $OUTDIR"
puts "LIBS     = $lib_list"

elaborate $TOP
check_design -unresolved > $OUTDIR/reports/check_unresolved_pre_sdc.rpt

if {[file exists $SDC]} {
    read_sdc $SDC
} else {
    puts "WARNING: SDC file not found; continuing without constraints"
}

set_db syn_generic_effort medium
set_db syn_map_effort medium
set_db syn_opt_effort medium

syn_generic
syn_map
syn_opt

report_qor > $OUTDIR/reports/qor.rpt
report_area > $OUTDIR/reports/area.rpt
report_timing -max_paths 20 > $OUTDIR/reports/timing.rpt
report_power > $OUTDIR/reports/power.rpt
report_gates > $OUTDIR/reports/gates.rpt
check_design > $OUTDIR/reports/check_design_post_syn.rpt
report_mess
